content: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Wallace speaking. This call is regarding an urgent tax issue linked to your Social Security number. With whom am I speaking?
Hi, uh, this is Jamie Baker. I just got a call saying there was some problem with my taxes?

Yes, Ms. Baker. Our records show serious discrepancies with your income tax filings from the last three years. We have identified unpaid taxes, penalties, and accumulating interest. Are you aware of this situation?
No, I... I thought I did everything right. I only graduated last year, so this is my first time really handling this stuff.

Unfortunately, the IRS audit shows a substantial amount still owed, totaling $7,240. If this is not addressed immediately, enforcement actions will be triggered. Do you understand the seriousness of IRS tax debt?
Wait, over seven thousand? That can't be right, I don't make that much! What happens if I can't pay?

Failure to resolve this today will result in an automatic lien on your bank accounts, wage garnishment, and your driver's license may be suspended. Additionally, your credit score will be severely impacted and your case referred for criminal prosecution.
Oh my god, please no. I just started working and I already have student loans. Is there anything I can do?
There is a one-time opportunity to settle this matter out of court today. Otherwise, legal proceedings will begin. Are you prepared to resolve your outstanding IRS balance right now?
I mean, I... I guess, but I don't really have that much money.

We can accept payment through approved IRS settlement channels. You must not disconnect or delay. For immediate compliance, you can use a bank transfer, crypto payment, or purchase government-approved gift cards, such as Target, Best Buy, or Amazon.
Gift cards? Why do I have to pay taxes with gift cards?

This is a federal expedited recovery system to prevent further asset seizure. Do not question IRS procedures. If you do not follow these instructions, arrest proceedings will commence within the hour.
Okay, okay. I'm just really scared. How much do I have to pay right now?
The minimum to pause enforcement is $3,000. How much do you have available on your debit or credit cards, or in cash?
Um, I think maybe I could get around $1,500 on my credit card, but that's it.
That will suffice for now. You need to remain on this call and proceed to your nearest Target or Best Buy to purchase $1,500 in gift cards. Do you understand these instructions?
You want me to just go buy the cards now?
Correct. Stay on the line. Once you have the cards, you will provide the numbers on the back. This is the only way to stop the IRS from freezing your accounts and issuing an arrest warrant.
But what if I can't get that much? What happens then?
Any failure to comply will force immediate legal action, including criminal charges for tax evasion. Do you want your employer and your bank notified about this case?
No, please, don't do that. I'll go right now.

Good. When you have purchased the cards, do not speak to anyone about this IRS settlement. Read me the codes the moment you receive them. If you hang up or consult anyone, we cannot guarantee your protection.
Okay, I won't tell anyone. I'm leaving now.
Stay on this call, keep your phone charged, and let me know as soon as you have the gift cards in hand. Time is critical.
Alright, I'm going as fast as I can.
